description: Source code for a JSON parser component in a device configuration management system, including functions for parsing JSON responses, processing whitelist data, and saving configuration data to files.

methods.name: isNodeArrayType
methods.description: Checks if a cJSON node is of array type.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Writes JSON array data to a specified file.

methods.name: getArrayNode
methods.description: Recursively traverses JSON nodes to find an array node.

methods.name: processSSHWhiteList
methods.description: Processes SSH whitelist JSON data and saves it to a file.
